parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set system login user rtb authentication.template: set system login user [parameter1] authentication plain-text-password [parameter2]
set system login user rtb authentication.command: set system login user rtb authentication plain-text-password "@%@%j]v~7%f[#S'W>j9zzM)3,*!u@%@%"
set system login user rtb authentication.explanation: 配置系统登录用户的认证密码。

set system services aaa authentication-o.template: set system services aaa authentication-order [ parameter1 ]
set system services aaa authentication-o.command: set system services aaa authentication-order [ password ]

set interfaces lmp-1/0/0 unit 0 family i.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces lmp-1/0/0 unit 0 family i.command: set interfaces lmp-1/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.110.0.1/24
set interfaces lmp-1/0/0 unit 0 family i.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces lmp-1/0/0 ppp-options cha.command: set interfaces lmp-1/0/0 ppp-options chap local-name rta
set interfaces lmp-1/0/0 ppp-options cha.explanation: 配置PPP CHAP认证的本地名称。

set interfaces lmp-1/0/0 ppp-options cha.command: set interfaces lmp-1/0/0 ppp-options chap default-challenge-response
set interfaces lmp-1/0/0 ppp-options cha.explanation: 启用PPP CHAP认证的默认挑战响应。

set access profile ppp-profile authentic.command: set access profile ppp-profile authentication-order password
set access profile ppp-profile authentic.explanation: 配置访问配置文件的认证顺序。
